promote.rationale: Career consular officer; canonical Vienna-Convention-on-Consular-Relations category; strongly attested in HK Cap.
Consulate (mission/building/staff); strongly attested in HK Cap. (Consular Relations Ordinance Cap. 557).
Formal accrediting of diplomatic/consular agents to a receiving state; canonical recognition concept, strongly attested.
Emblems (Red Cross, national insignia): protected categories under HK Cap. 295 (Geneva Conventions Act) and Cap. 315; standard IHL concept.
National/diplomatic insignia: canonical recognition / sovereign-symbol category, strongly attested.
Relations (consular/diplomatic relations): canonical Vienna-Convention category, strongly attested in HK Cap.
Consequential amendments in implementing-treaty Cap. (recognition pass-through provisions); strongly attested.
Cover (diplomatic/consular cover, sovereign-immunity scope of cover); strongly attested in HK Cap.
Foreign element: gateway concept for jurisdiction, conflict-of-laws and recognition; very strongly attested.
External (crime/jurisdiction): canonical HK Cap. term for offences committed outside HK with an HK link.
Outward (extradition / removal): used in HK Cap. fugitive-offender regime to denote movement out of HK jurisdiction.
Voyage (international voyage): standard jurisdictional/maritime category in HK Cap. 369 and aviation/maritime treaty implementation.
Non-international: used in HK Cap. to distinguish domestic from international voyages/flights for jurisdictional purposes.
Cross-boundary: canonical HK jurisdictional concept (PRC-HK boundary, MLA, mutual recognition); strongly attested.
IMO: principal UN agency for maritime international law; HK Cap. 369 and others give effect to IMO conventions.
WTO: cornerstone of international trade dispute settlement; HK is a separate WTO member under BL art.151.
ICAO: principal UN agency for civil aviation, foundational to the Chicago Convention regime applied via HK Cap. 448 and 503.
WHO: international public-health treaty body; HK Cap. ordinances implement WHO IHR/regulations.
Arbitral (adj.): canonical dispute-settlement modifier (arbitral tribunal, arbitral award); strongly attested in HK Cap. 609 and treaty-implementing ordinances.
International Standard: standardisation framework underlying treaty implementation (ISO/Codex/IEC) referenced in HK Cap. for technical-treaty regimes.
IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards): treaty-derived international standard regime applied via HK Cap. 622 and HKICPA; strongly attested.
Customarily / customary practice: foundational source of international law (custom alongside treaty); strongly attested in HK Cap. usage.
Sino-British Joint Liaison Group: the bespoke transitional body for the 1997 handover; uniquely a HK external-relations institution.
Ministry of Foreign Affairs (PRC): the national authority handling HK foreign affairs under BL art.13; strongly attested in HK Cap.
European Communities/EU: HK has had distinct external-relations status with the EC/EU since pre-1997 (trade arrangements); strongly attested.
British (national/subject): canonical HK post-1997 external-relations category (BN(O), British nationality status); strongly attested.
Liaison: standard HK external-relations function (PRC-HK liaison, JLG, consular liaison); strongly attested.
International (obligation): the standard HK Cap. modifier flagging treaty-derived obligations under BL arts.151-153; very strongly attested.
War: foundational state-responsibility / IHL category; strongly attested in HK Cap. (Geneva Conventions Act, war-crimes regime, sanctions).
Military (forces/operations): canonical state-responsibility / jurisdictional category (visiting forces, military offences) in HK Cap.

confidence_self_assessment.rationale: Strong: clear separation of mis-classified covenant-family entries (civil/property) from genuine international-law lexicon; canonical doctrinal terms preserved as kunder4 within the 5-cap; balanced sub-area coverage with no bucket exceeding 10. Moderate uncertainty: (i) several promotes with knn_confidence in [0.286, 0.571] band were judged on doctrinal grounds (e.g. 'customarily', 'cover', 'consequential') and may carry signal noise; (ii) HK Cap. attestation can mask dictionary-collocation rather than substantive use; (iii) some sub-area assignments are borderline (e.g. 'safeguard' could equally sit in dispute_settlement). The 5 kunder4 slots are all spent on canonical international-law doctrines with case-law-primary HK presence, leaving no buffer for further marginal exceptions (notably 'comity', dropped).

weakest_decisions.concern: 'consequential' (promoted to recognition_immunity, conf=0.429): general legislative term; doctrinal fit weaker than ideal, retained as recognition pass-through anchor.
'cover' (promoted to recognition_immunity, conf=0.429): polysemous (insurance cover, scope cover, diplomatic cover); strict-gate clean but semantic noise risk.
'IFRS' (promoted to dispute_settlement, conf=0.286): low knn confidence; sub-area assignment debatable (could be administrative/financial), retained for treaty-derived international-standard angle.
'military' (promoted to state_responsibility, conf=0.286): low knn confidence; HK Cap. usage is mostly visiting-forces and offences, not state responsibility per se.
'conventional' was dropped despite passing strict gate, on near-synonym/derivative grounds; defensible but a judgement call.

'comity' was dropped (k 0/1) because the 5-slot kunder4 budget was fully committed to forum non conveniens / jus cogens / pacta sunt servanda / extraterritoriality / extradition. Comity is a doctrinally serious omission; mitigated partially by promoted 'reciprocal' and 'mutual'.

notes: International-law domain has limited HK Cap. statutory presence (statutes give effect to treaties rather than codify international law itself), so the curation prioritised: (a) the canonical doctrinal vocabulary of treaty law, jurisdiction, recognition/immunity, dispute settlement; (b) the HK-specific external-relations institutions (JLG, BL arts.151-153 framework, MFA-PRC, BN(O), EC/EU); (c) IHL/state-responsibility anchors via Geneva Conventions Act, NSL, WTO Safeguards. Out-of-domain entries cleared from the current core: the entire 'covenant' family in its civil/property sense (covenantee, covenantor, Deed of Mutual Covenant, restrictive/curtilage/non-competition covenant, covenant) was mis-classified by the upstream pipeline because of the lexical overlap with the ICCPR/ICESCR sense (which is preserved as 'Covenant', idx 359). Specific named conventions with weak HK attestation (Geneva, Rome, NYC, Single Convention, Rhine Navigation, TEU, ECHR, MIGA) were dropped in favour of the generic 'convention' / 'agreement' / 'treaty' anchors plus the high-attestation HK-applied instruments (Hague, Paris, PCT, Civil Procedure Convention).
